# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not** open a public issue, discussion, or pull request for a security vulnerability.

Use one of these private channels instead:

- **GitHub:** [Report it through Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/acevedo-daniel/dms-demo/security/advisories/new).
- **Direct contact:** Contact the repository maintainer through their GitHub profile if private reporting is unavailable.

### What to include

- The affected component, route, dependency, and version.
- A concise impact assessment.
- Steps to reproduce or a minimal proof of concept.
- Known mitigations, if any.

### Response targets

| Step               | Target                                         |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- |
| Acknowledgment     | Within 48 hours                                |
| Initial assessment | Within 5 business days                         |
| Fix or mitigation  | Best effort, communicated through the advisory |

## Supported versions

| Version |  Status   |
| ------- | :-------: |
| main    | Supported |

## Scope

This policy covers the source code and configuration in this repository. Report vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies to their respective maintainers as well.

## Demo data

This repository is a public demonstration and contains only fictional data. Do not include real patient, client, clinical, authentication, or other sensitive information in a security report.

## Recognition

Contributors who responsibly disclose valid vulnerabilities may be acknowledged in release notes or the advisory, unless they prefer to remain anonymous.
